name: Laposta Subscribe
description: Provides a block with a subscribe form for the Laposta email service.
project_description:
This module provides seamless integration with Laposta , a leading email marketing service based in the Netherlands. Laposta Subscribe makes it effortless for your website users or visitors to manage their subscriptions to your email list, allowing them to easily opt in. The module enables you to create and manage a subscription form directly from your Drupal site. Key features include:

 Features 
 
 Simple API integration with Laposta 
 Newsletter subscription form 
 Configuration through Drupal's admin interface 
 Support for Honeypot 
 Form validation and error handling 
 Twig template included 
 
 Supporting this Module
